OmniDirector: General Multi-Shot Camera Cloning without Cross-Paired Data
sent.short_intro: This paper tackles the problem of cloning camera motion from reference videos for multi-shot video generation. Existing methods struggle with multi-shot scenarios or require scarce cross-paired data. The authors propose OmniDirector, a unified framework that uses a novel camera grid representation and is trained on million-scale camera grid-video pairs to achieve director-level control.

sent.title: APPO: Agentic Procedural Policy Optimization
sent.short_intro: This paper addresses the challenge of credit assignment in multi-turn tool-use for large language model agents. It proposes APPO, a method that identifies fine-grained decision points in sequences for branching and credit assignment, improving agentic reinforcement learning performance.

sent.title: Memory is Reconstructed, Not Retrieved: Graph Memory for LLM Agents
sent.short_intro: LLM agents struggle to reason over long interaction histories because current memory systems use a static retrieve-then-reason approach. This paper introduces MRAgent, which represents memory as a graph and uses an active reconstruction mechanism to dynamically adapt memory access during reasoning. The framework significantly improves performance on long-horizon memory tasks while reducing token and runtime costs.
